あらすじ

Kabukicho—There exists a night town where people wander in search of healing. Tetsuro, the story’s protagonist, works there as a host who turns women’s goodwill into money as he lives his dull everyday life…

…That was when he met her. A lonely girl named Asuka who seeks for true love. Thus begins her life in the sensual love business.
